The main takeaway from our work is that
MOST is able to detect the lower overtones of the radial p-modes of η Boo, which are not detectable in the ground-based spectroscopic observations.

the lower frequency modes of MOST are an important new tool for probing stellar interiors, especially when combined with the ground-based spectroscopic data that are sensitive to higher frequency modes.
